name: pace-line
description: Coloured usage band above the prompt (model, folder, branch, context, cost, time, 5h/7d pace) plus a Slurm batch-job watcher: progress, live loss charts, GPUs, checkpoints, alerts and auto-resume.

pollSeconds.title: squeue every (s)
pollSeconds.description: How often squeue is read for your batch jobs.

gpuSeconds.title: GPU refresh (s)
gpuSeconds.description: GPU refresh for the job selected in /jobs, while the panel is open.

idleMinutes.title: Idle GPU alert (min)
idleMinutes.description: Alert when an allocated GPU has been idle this long.

silentMinutes.title: Silent log alert (min)
silentMinutes.description: Alert when a running job's log hasn't grown in this long.

nearLimitMinutes.title: Near time limit (min)
nearLimitMinutes.description: Alert when a job has this little time left.

staleCkptMinutes.title: Stale checkpoint (min)
staleCkptMinutes.description: Alert when the newest checkpoint is this old.

pendingMinutes.title: Long pending (min)
pendingMinutes.description: Alert when a job has been pending this long.

maxResumes.title: Auto-resumes per chain
maxResumes.description: Automatic resubmits from a checkpoint per job chain before asking.

discordChatId.title: Discord chat id
discordChatId.description: Your Discord DM chat id; alerts go there through the Discord plugin.

discordWebhook.title: Discord webhook URL
discordWebhook.description: A Discord webhook URL, used when the Discord plugin isn't connected.
